justification: Inspected byte-buddy-gradle-plugin/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/build/gradle/package-info.java and the exact-package sources. The package contains 21 Java classes totaling 4,419 LOC; the largest files are AbstractByteBuddyTask.java (703 LOC), AbstractByteBuddyTaskExtension.java (498 LOC), and ByteBuddyPlugin.java (427 LOC). Responsibilities are concentrated in one package across plugin wiring, task execution, task/configuration extensions, discovery, incremental resolution, logging, object factory support, and transformation/model classes, which is strong evidence of a God Component.
